notes: Large-source unit בְּעֵבֶר → *beyond* retained: a preposition on a construct noun rendered by one English word fuses and heads on the construct (rules 30, 23); לָמָּה → *why* likewise, headed on מָה.
The fronted *did* of *did he remain* is the verb's own, since the clause's interrogative word לָמָּה already holds an English word of its own (rule 17's second limit).
Margin *Or, shore* read and set aside (rule 38).
